amendments.amendment: id=lstm-tuning-fallback. The pre-registered tuning sweep (3 learning rates x 3 entropy coefficients x 3 seeds, 300k transitions, validation only) was uninformative for the LSTM: every configuration finished within noise of an untrained policy (validation survival 99.7-106.7; the 106.7 ties are the untrained deterministic policy), so 'first best in grid order' would have selected lr=1e-4 by tie-break. Decision, made before any memory-track run: the LSTM and the SSM use the feedforward sweep's selected pair (lr=1e-3, entropy=0.003). The difference in tuning effort is recorded here and in the manifest, and the memory-track comparison is not called controlled with respect to tuning. No other plan item is changed.

id=v2.1-exists. AdaptArena v2.1 exists (analysis_plan_v2_1.yaml with its own SHA-256 and tag plan-v2.1-lock). v2 is unchanged: this plan, its hash, its earlier amendments, its locked suite and its access log are not edited, and the published v2 claims stand.

id=v2.1-lock-record. (1) The tag plan-v2.1-lock could not be pushed from the build environment (the git proxy rejects tag refs); the lock commit is 8e86d2339f1613df5d39d3297671cb13a16dd846 on branch claude/jolly-darwin-mg8qjo, pushed before suite_test_v2_1.json was generated, which the access log shows by commit hash. Tags are unsigned. (2) Two generation attempts of suite_test_v2_1.json were interrupted before any file was written (the first hit a background time limit while the CPU was shared; the second looped forever because the layout-exclusion rule made the single-layout familiar condition unsatisfiable). No suite was produced or read by either attempt. The exclusion rule was fixed so familiar is excluded by scenario id only, and the third attempt produced the suite. The access log therefore holds three generation entries.
